payload.description:
A handful of Kanbus chores that exercise the full spot loop (find work, claim, execute, verify, close) at near-zero cost, so the dispatch machinery can be tested repeatedly without burning quota or CPU.

Each dummy routine must be: one or two shell commands, no repo mutation, verifiable from the Kanbus comment it leaves. Labeled spot:claude so only the Claude worker picks them up.
payload.title: Cheap dummy spot routines for dispatch testing
